text_block_list.text:
A piece of fan mail arrived
for Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, Trainer!
Look what someone wrote in my fan letter!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing you never give up gives me courage."
...It says! That's a little embarrassing, ehehe!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Listen! This is a secret, but I did my best today and held back with just two carrots!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"So I know I can definitely win next time!
Do you think that'll make this little one even happier!?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, that's right! They're gonna love it!
All right, I'm gonna work even harder-!!
Haru Urara's motivation seemed to rise with the support from her fans.
